thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH error-rate on inference-gateway (prod-usw2). 5xx rate = 7.1% over 5m (threshold 3%). Link: https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 created, auto-page -> @oncall-alex. Severity: P1. Affected customers: 12 active requests failing.

oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. grabbing runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-gateway-5xx

sre-maya: Thanks. Initial ask: do we have a recent deploy to prod-usw2 in the last 10m?

eng-runtime-james: No deploy that I see in the last 30m. Metric looks like sudden ramp in backend 502 from kvcache tier. Query: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5..",job="inference-gw",region="usw2"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-gw",region="usw2"}[1m]))` shows spike.

oncall-alex: ok Maya, start isolation. Can someone toggle fallback routing to eu-west for non-enterprise traffic? We want to keep the control plane stable.

eng-runtime-james: I can flip routing. Doing staged reroute: 10% -> 30% -> 100% unless errors follow. Command I will run:
```
# ramp traffic slice to eu-west
rdctl routes update inference-gw --region us-west-2 --spill-to eu-west1 --weight 10
```

support-jon: FYI CS is seeing three customers reporting generator timeouts. Raising priority to do quick customer check-ins after mitigation.

product-lia: Noted — please add customer-impact tag to the incident and paste list when available.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by oncall-alex.

eng-runtime-james: ramped to 30% now. Error rate on us-west-2 dropped from 7.1% -> 4.8% in 2m. eu-west1 is healthy.

oncall-alex: good. continue to 100% if stability holds. Also request SRE to check kvcache pod restarts and connection graphs.

eng-runtime-james: ramped to 100%. Confirming global 5xx rate back to 0.9% across prod.

sre-maya: observed many kvcache OOM restarts on us-west-2 AZ b. Pod restart count: `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=kvcache -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount` shows 12 restarts on kvcache-azb. Kernel OOMs in node logs. Creating node drain job and adding taint to avoid new scheduling.

oncall-alex: good triage. James, do we want to keep traffic spilled or move back?

eng-runtime-james: Keep spill for now until we patch/replace the faulty nodes. I'll keep controlled spill with weight 0 for us-west-2 (i.e., 100% eu-west) and prepare rollback steps to revert after nodes are healthy.

support-jon: Starting proactive outreach to the three affected customers. Draft message: "We've mitigated an error spike affecting some requests, routing traffic to healthy region; continuing investigation; will update in 30m."

product-lia: add scheduled update at +30m. Also mark incident with "potential-customer-impact" and link to ticket queue.

incident-bot: Update: Incident INC12345 status -> Mitigated (traffic spilled). PagerDuty: waiting for confirm/resolve step.

oncall-alex: I'll keep incident open. Handing off at 1:00 UTC to night rotation. @sre-maya and @eng-runtime-james please leave notes about followups (node replacement, capacity patch, postmortem owner).

eng-runtime-james: Notes added to the incident: replacing two nodes in usw2-azb, investigating kernel OOM pattern, suspected noisy neighbor VM. Postmortem owner: james/runtime.

sre-maya: I will schedule node replacement now and run soak tests after. Also enable kvcache memory cgroup limit bump for next deploy.

oncall-alex: thanks team. Closing active pager now, we'll transition to incident channel and update PD after handoff.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 resolved by oncall-alex. Please track follow-up in #incidents for the postmortem.

product-lia: Thanks. Keep updates in incident doc and ping me if rollback is required.

support-jon: Customer updates queued. Will follow up after postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Log summary appended to INC12345: initial 5xx spike 7.1% -> mitigated by traffic spill to eu-west1; root cause: node-level OOM on kvcache in us-west-2 AZ-b; remediation: node replacement and kvcache memory limit increase; follow-ups assigned to james/runtime and maya/sre.

noncall-alex: handing off -> oncall-kate for overnight. cc @oncall-kate 

oncall-kate: acked, taking over. Keeping watch.

end of thread.
